test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

What evil magic does / it possess to draw the human / heart so powerful to it?

options.text: it possess to draw the human

solution:
The correct answer is Option (1) i.e. "**heart so powerful to it?"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"so powerful"** is incorrectly used as an adjective when an adverb is needed to modify the verb "draw."
 
• The **correct adverbial form **should be **"so powerfully"** to properly describe the action of drawing.
 
• This **error disrupts** the grammatical flow and clarity of the sentence.
 
• The corrected segment improves readability and maintains grammatical consistency.

Therefore, the correct answer is *heart so powerfully to it?*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option (2): **What evil magic does—This segment is grammatically correct and serves as the opening clause posing a question.
 
• **Option (4):** it possess to draw the human—This segment is also grammatically correct and aligns with the rest of the sentence structurally.
